name: PII & Regulated Data Protection
description: Rules for detecting and intercepting payment cards, national identity numbers, and sensitive health/financial disclosures.

rules.description: US Social Security Numbers in standard hyphenated format
Canadian Social Insurance Numbers (formatted 3-3-3 runs or explicit SIN context verified with Luhn)
Payment card number runs (13-19 digits evaluated via Luhn algorithm)
Personal financial and account keywords on outbound publishing tools
rules.pattern: \b(?:account number|routing number|cvv|iban|swift code|tax return|wire transfer|mortgage statement)\b

rules.description: Sensitive healthcare, diagnosis, and medical terms on outbound publishing tools
